name: IndieProducts.io

sources.title: Homepage — 'Submit your SaaS, Newsletter, Extension, App or Agency'; Next.js app, Google sign-in gate
FAQ — manual verification of niche/category; NSFW listings rejected

requirements: Accepts SaaS, newsletters, extensions, apps, and agencies
Google sign-in required — 'Get Started by Signing In!' with 'Sign in with Google'
Manual review: submissions go live only after the team verifies niche, category, and details
preparation: Optional: a square/tile image — the site runs a 'Million Dot Homepage' mechanic ('claim your square')
workflow: Open https://www.indieproducts.io/ and sign in with Google
Use the on-page submit flow to enter product details
Submission shows 'Product submitted successfully' and enters the manual verification queue
Listing goes live after the niche/category/details check passes
watchFor: Site is low-maintenance (footer 'Copyright © 2023') — review turnaround may be slow
Low domain authority (third-party lists cite DA ~3) — SEO value modest
'For advertising and collaboration dm @' on Twitter — some placements may be pay-to-play via DM
Client-rendered Next.js app — needs JS for the submit form
countsAsLive: The product appears on the IndieProducts listing/grid (and Million Dot Homepage square) after manual verification
unknowns: Exact form fields beyond product name/URL — the form is behind Google sign-in
